name: net_boss_intro_2p
description: VUH-2289: two players on the player package's shipped defaults. The host warps into the BC Thresholder room with its intro (05/0B btl72 evt32767) while the client is still in GoA, so the client's cutscene hold opens its pause menu outside the event room. In two-player play the TARGET_ALL clone seats Sora as a companion, which used to crash that menu at exe+0x36A4AB. The client must survive the hold, follow into the boss room and move afterwards.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))
[log_count('[partyempty] seven native row/menu guards installed', i) for i in range(2)]==[1,1]
steps.message: The pause-menu companion guard is not installed with the shipped defaults

steps.name: 1 Boss intro: client held outside the event room

steps.message: The two-player clone party leaf was not applied on the client, so this run cannot show the crash guard

steps.expr: all(any(a.get('objectId')==353 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(2))
log_count('released=1', 1)>=1 or log_count('owner did not converge', 1)>=1

steps.message: The client could not move after the boss intro (input still held)
